title: Persistent General tab that cannot be hidden or closed
author: bartuszekj
body_snippet: I just upgraded from v1.78.2-NB-3228 to v1.78.2-NB-3702, and now I have a persistent General tab that is a parent to all remote desktop connections that cannot be hidden or collapsed and takes up valuable real estate: In Options -> Tabs & panels, all settings are unchecked, including "Create an empty panel when mRemoteNG starts" and "Always show panel tabs".
